title: What is the average math score of the school with the lowest average score
question:
What is the average math score of the school with the lowest average score for all subjects, and in which county is it located?
Benchmark knowledge evidence: Average score for all subjects can be computed by AvgScrMath + AvgScrRead + AvgScrWrite

prediction.sql:
SELECT s.XCL_038
FROM satscores s
JOIN schools sc ON s.XCL_030 = sc.XCL_041
WHERE s.XCL_037 IS NOT NULL AND s.XCL_038 IS NOT NULL AND s.XCL_039 IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY (s.XCL_037 + s.XCL_038 + s.XCL_039) ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT 
    AVG(s.XCL_037) AS avg_math_score,
    sc.XCL_046 AS county
FROM satscores s
JOIN schools sc ON s.XCL_030 = sc.XCL_041
WHERE s.XCL_030 = (
    SELECT s2.XCL_030
    FROM satscores s2
    GROUP BY s2.XCL_030
    ORDER BY AVG(s2.XCL_035 + s2.XCL_036 + s2.XCL_037 + s2.XCL_038 + s2.XCL_039 + s2.XCL_040) ASC
    LIMIT 1
)
